request.what: Withdraw treasury funds to support Intersect Technical Steering Committee activities for 12 months across community engagement, protocol governance, and independent technical review.

claims.claim: The proposal requests $298,250, stated as 1,193,000 ADA, to support TSC activities for 12 months.
The work packages are budgeted at 256,000 ADA for WP1, 832,000 ADA for WP2, and 105,000 ADA for WP3, totaling 1,193,000 ADA.
WP2 funds three specialist groups: the Parameter Committee, CIP editors, and Hard Fork Working Group.

WP3 will establish a pilot independent technical review programme in 2027 with conflict-of-interest provisions, recorded and published recusals, and open reviewer selection against documented criteria.
The proposal states that all expenditure will be fully accounted for and unspent funds returned to the Cardano treasury.
The proposal states that execution of the work packages is contingent on approval of the IntersectMBO budget proposal.
The proposal claims it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and provides references to voting documentation and audited results.
The proposal claims the requested amount did not breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit at submission and links to the relevant governance action.

Independent audits and assurance for this proposal will be provided by Appold, with possible reviews including deliverable verification, control testing, spend validation, and milestone evidence assessment.

Intersect says treasury administration will use Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with listed TRSC and PSSC addresses, defined multisignature permissions, external oversight entities, audit references, and a public dashboard.

summary: The document requests 1,193,000 ADA for 12 months of TSC support, split across technical coordination, protocol governance groups, and a pilot technical review program, with asserted accounting, external assurance, smart-contract-based fund management, and several externally checkable references.
